summary: Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its Annual Meeting of Stockholders held June 16, 2026, disclosing voting results for director elections, advisory say-on-pay, auditor ratification, and approval of the 2026 Omnibus Stock Incentive Plan. All proposals passed. The filing also notes post-meeting committee appointments. This is a routine 8-K required under Items 5.07 and 8.01; no special situation (change of control, restructuring, acquisition, or other event) is present. No deal terms, prices, or strategic catalysts are disclosed. The filing reflects ordinary governance and compensation matters.
